frames.name: Pilgrim Frame
frames.starting_rule: The first workshop always includes flexible maintenance.
frames.tradeoff: No specialised protection or repair grace.
frames.description: A mismatched travelling chassis that can become almost anything.

frames.name: Surveyor Frame
frames.starting_rule: Interrupted repair work continues briefly while the Saint repositions.
frames.description: Long legs, a folding map arm, and just enough time to reconsider a route.

frames.name: Keeper Frame
frames.starting_rule: The first heavy shove each wave moves the Saint only half as far.
frames.description: A broad waterworks shell that remembers how to remain where it is needed.
